plugin.name: Tony Hawk Pro Skater 4 Fusion Fix
MAIN.ResX.description: Render width in pixels. If either dimension is 0, use the desktop resolution. Restart required.
MAIN.ResY.description: Render height in pixels. If either dimension is 0, use the desktop resolution. Restart required.
MAIN.FOVFactor.description: Gameplay field-of-view multiplier on top of widescreen correction. 1.0 preserves the intended framing. Applies to normal local-player follow cameras, excluding fixed, animated and script-overridden views.
MAIN.TextLanguage.description: Language of the fix's texts in the Plugins menu. Automatic follows the game's language and uses English when it has no translation.
menu.title: Advanced Options
menu.settingsfilehelp: Shows the settings file in File Explorer
WindowMode.description: Fullscreen, a framed window, or a borderless window. Alt+Enter switches fullscreen and the last window mode while retaining the render resolution.
SkipIntro.description: Skips the Activision, Aspyr and Neversoft logos and the intro movie at startup. Options > Movies still plays them. Takes effect when the game starts.
MAIN.FMVWidescreenMode.description: Original aspect shows the movies as the game does, whole inside its centred 4:3 frame with black bars around them. Fill fits the whole movie to the screen, without cutting anything off or stretching it.
MAIN.HudAspectRatioConstraint.descriptio: Where the HUD sits on wide screens. Auto puts the score, special meter and stance at the left edge and the goal, cash and pro points at the right edge. A ratio such as 16:9 keeps them in a centred box of that shape (4:3 to 32:9). Elements in the middle of the screen stay centred.
MAIN_ConfineCursor.description: Keep the cursor inside the active game window. Released while unfocused, dragging or using system menus. Turning this off releases it immediately.
menu.restoredefaultshelp: Restore this plugin's settings to their shipped defaults. Press again to confirm.
menu.restartwarning: Restart the game to apply changed startup settings.
menu.presethelp: Choose a preset, then press twice to apply it to this plugin.
FPSLimit.description: Limits presentation to the selected frame rate; 0 disables the limiter and -1 uses the desktop refresh rate. Changes apply immediately. 60 FPS is recommended; higher rates can break gameplay.
checkupdates.description: Check for a new fix version once when enabled. A notice appears in Plugins; FusionFixHub opens after the game exits if installed. Off makes no network request.
update.availablehub: An update for Tony Hawk Pro Skater 4 Fusion Fix is available. FusionFixHub will open after you exit the game.
update.availablesite: An update for Tony Hawk Pro Skater 4 Fusion Fix is available at fusionfix.io.
PauseOnFocusLoss.description: In a window mode, the game stops while another window is active, as it always did. Off keeps it running. Applies immediately.
